LanguageData.PUAH.allowCorpsesTooltip: Default Off. Only carry those directly in hands instead.
LanguageData.PUAH.allowAnimals: Allow tamed pack animals using their inventory for hauling
LanguageData.PUAH.allowAnimalsTooltip: Default On. Works best with mods that give backpacks to more animals, like VFME Caravan Packs
LanguageData.PUAH.allowMechanoids: Allow hacked mechanoids using their inventory for hauling
LanguageData.PUAH.allowMechanoidsTooltip: Requires What The Hack or similar mods. Default On.
LanguageData.PUAH.scanForClosestBestDestination: When unloading, scan for the closest best destination instead of picking the first unloadable
LanguageData.PUAH.scanForClosestBestDestinationToolti: For the trade-off of more processing time, unloading can be done more efficiently
LanguageData.PUAH.alwaysAllowPickup: Force allow pickup in home area for non-quest pawns
LanguageData.PUAH.alwaysAllowPickupTooltip: The home map has additional restrictions on what things can be picked up, this simplifies so remote maps and home maps behave the same
LanguageData.PUAH.stashInsteadOfDropOnNewJob: Auto-stash on new job if carrying a thing
LanguageData.PUAH.stashInsteadOfDropOnNewJobTooltip: Attempts to stash into inventory instead of dropping on the floor when starting a new job
LanguageData.PUAH.stashOnHarvestTooltip: Attempts to stash into inventory instead of having the harvest results drop on the floor
LanguageData.PUAH.stashOnRecipeFinish: Auto-stash on "drop on floor" bill finishes
LanguageData.PUAH.stashOnRecipeFinishTooltip: Attempts to stash into inventory for bill results for configured to "drop on floor"
LanguageData.PUAH.minimumFreeInventorySpace: Minimum free inventory space to consider hauling to inventory
LanguageData.PUAH.minimumFreeInventorySpaceTooltip: Pawns with less free inventory space than defined here just directly use vanilla hauling. 0% makes them always try hauling to inventory, regardless of them having room for more than one potato or not. 100% results in PUAH requiring pawns to be completely naked. Default 20%
